## Notes

Very entertaining, although I sometimes found the world hard to understand. I didn’t like the parts with too much poetry.

The characters are well developed, each with a unique story. I also liked how the reasons for their selection for the pilgrimage and the mystery of who the “traitor” was slowly unfolded.
